primitives.name: Local Development Environment Setup
primitives.verbatim_quote: Install dependencies ```bash git checkout -b local-bringup # never commit on `main` cd C:\Users\Garrett\Sports npm install # workspace install — installs apps/web + all packages/ ``` The `postinstall` hook runs `npm run db:generate` automatically (Prisma client generation).
primitives.assumptions: Workspace isolation requires clean branch and package installation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure at npm install or postinstall hook indicates missing Node.js or npm versions.

layer2.mapping: Dev setup mirrors production deployment pipeline with local overrides.
layer2.telemetry: Successful completion of npm install and prisma generation.

primitives.name: Database Path Selection Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### Path A — Stub DB, no Postgres (fastest first run) All DB reads return empty; `DEMO_PICKS_ENABLED=true` makes `/picks` and `/dashboard` render a deterministic 10-pick sample slate (all `result=PENDING`).
primitives.assumptions: Stub mode enables rapid prototyping without PostgreSQL dependency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When DATABASE_URL=stub, db:push and db:seed are skipped.

layer2.mapping: Path selection determines whether to initialize real or mock database layers.
layer2.telemetry: Verification of db:push/db:seed execution based on DATABASE_URL value.

primitives.name: Admin Authentication Bypass
primitives.verbatim_quote: The seed creates the user row with `role=ADMIN`, so the Prisma adapter links the OAuth account and you land in `/cockpit` as admin.
primitives.assumptions: Synthetic admin session is restricted to non-production environments.
primitives.breakdown_regime: In production, DEV_FAKE_ADMIN is ignored due to NODE_ENV check.

layer2.mapping: Authentication bypass enables dev-only access control without external identity providers.
layer2.telemetry: Auth flow returns synthetic ADMIN role when DEV_FAKE_ADMIN=true.
